lines.differs: Better for AtliQ than Trustline NBFC: 30-day payment term instead of 45 days.
Same as PayTrack Technologies: 30-day payment term and invoicing upon milestone completion or acceptance.
Same as Sunrise Foods: 30-day payment term and invoicing upon milestone completion or acceptance.
Worse for AtliQ than Acme Retail Group: penalty triggers for any attributable delay instead of only for delays solely attributable to AtliQ.
Worse for AtliQ than Sunrise Foods: penalties apply to project milestones at 0.5% per week, whereas the past clause only penalized monthly support service levels.
Better for AtliQ than Brightwater Insurance Inc: 0.5% of the milestone fee per week capped at 5%, against 1% of total contract value per day.
